tspan.tspan: There are two trees: blue and orange, each containing mostly apples of
their own color but also some of the other color.
Each of your actions picks apples from one of the two trees for a while (left
image), and occasionally switches to the other tree (right image). On each
trial, you are shown a sample of the apples that you picked.
Your goal is to pick apples from the tree that is requested at the start of the
(when you are relatively unsure). You can monitor whether you should
